findings.evidence: Provider publication uses the canonical configured repository URL rather than mutable origin, removing remote-redirection authority from the model-controlled checkout.
The OpenCode model process is isolated from GitHub/Git/SSH publication credentials and runs with a credential-isolated HOME and Git configuration.
Each OpenCode attempt uses a disposable clone, so failed or rate-limited state cannot contaminate the next fallback provider attempt.
The inherited Issue #442 hostile-review artifact is replaced by this candidate-specific Issue #441 review, bound to the exact current content rather than inherited base evidence.
